blurb: Blue Turtle Bay Marina offers boat slip rentals accommodating boats up to 70 feet with shore power and fresh water connections. They provide premium pontoon, tritoon, and double decker boat rentals including safety gear and a full tank of gas. The marina also features a full-service fuel dock, secure trailer storage, and an on-site restaurant.
